advanced-filter-description: akalanakeka kānana alalowaka i walike he kakalinaka konakaininaka polalowinaka opelakolaka: == != <= >= && || ( ) he kapake he hoʻohana ʻia aka he kepalakola ma waena ka opelakolaka. ʻoe hiki kānana pola a pau naā kahua hoʻopilikino na kawapinaka keila nameka a lalueka. pola laʻana: pielaka1 == waiwai1. noke: ipa pielakaka a i ʻole lalueka loaʻa kapakeka, ʻoe neeka i enakapakulake kema inako kinakale kuokeka. pola laʻana: 'pielaka 1' == 'waiwai 1'. pola kinakale konakalola kalakakelaka (' \/) i he kakipapeka, ʻoe hiki hoʻohana \. pola laʻana: pielaka1 == i\'ma. kekahi ʻoe hiki komapine mulakipale konakikionaka. pola laʻana: pa1 == la1 || pa1 == la2. nolamalalawa a pau opelakolaka he inakelapalekeka mai hema i ʻākau. ʻoe hiki hoʻololi ka olakela na palakinaka palakakekaka. pola laʻana: pa1 == la1 && ( pa2 == la2 || pa2 == la3 ). kekahi ʻoe hiki ʻimi kikokikona pielakaka ukinaka lekeka: pa1 == /keka.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Pili i ka wā i hana ʻia ai kekahi kāleka, a i ʻole i loli ʻia ai kona poʻo inoa a wehewehe paha, a loaʻa i ka kikokikona hou kēia (ʻaʻole ʻike ʻia nā huapalapala nui a liʻiliʻi).

import-board-instruction-kanboard: kāpili he kanapoalaka hoʻokuʻu aku JSON: he opakekaka me "columns" (a i ʻole kakakaka kalalawinaka column_name) a he "tasks" alalawa (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). kolumanaka pekome nā papa inoa a kakakaka pekome nā kāleka.
import-board-instruction-deck: kāpili he nekakakalouka kekaka papa JSON (he papa me "stacks", eaka kakakaka kalalawinaka ikaka "cards"). kakakakaka pekome nā papa inoa a nā kāleka pekome nā kāleka.
import-board-instruction-openproject: kāpili he openapalokekaka wolakapakakakeka kolalekakiona JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). kakakukeka pekome nā papa inoa a wolaka pakakakeka pekome nā kāleka.
import-board-instruction-issues: kāpili he __sourceName__ ikakueka JSON alalawa (__endpoint__). ikakueka pekome nā kāleka kaloupeka inako wehe / pani ʻia nā papa inoa.
import-board-instruction-asana: kāpili he akana kakakaka hoʻokuʻu aku JSON ({ "data": [...] } mai ka akana hoʻokuʻu aku a i ʻole GET /tasks). kakakaka he kaloupeka inako kekakionaka (memapelakipaka); pau kakakaka ko i kone.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: kāpili he kenakika papa inoa hoʻokuʻu aku JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). kakakeka pekome nā papa inoa a nā mea pekome nā kāleka.
import-board-instruction-markdown: E hoʻopili i kahi papa inoa hana markdown (ke ʻano hoʻohana o nā mea hana markdown-kanban e like me Obsidian Kanban): nā poʻo inoa "## Inoa papa inoa", me nā mea "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ma lalo. Lilo nā poʻo inoa i papa inoa a lilo nā mea i kāleka; e komo pū ana kekahi papa inoa maʻalahi me ka ʻole o kāleka koho, ma ke ʻano he mau kāleka hāmama.
import-board-instruction-leo: Hoʻopili i kekahi kūkulu Leo (waihona .leo). Lilo nā māhele ma ka pae kiʻekiʻe loa i mau papa inoa, a lilo nā māhele ma lalo pono o lākou i mau kāleka, me ke kikokikona o ka māhele i wehewehe no ke kāleka. Lilo nā māhele ma nā pae hohonu aʻe i mau papa nānā. Hoʻokomo ʻia nā māhele i kaha ʻia me ke kūlana ua pau.
import-board-instruction-opml: Hoʻopili i ka papa kuhi OPML i hoʻopuka ʻia e Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq a me nā mea hana papa kuhi ʻē aʻe. Lilo nā mea ma ka pae luna i mau papa inoa, ko lākou mau keiki i mau kāleka me ka memo ma ke ʻano he wehewehe, a nā mea ma nā pae hohonu aʻe i mau papa hōʻoia. Hoʻokomo ʻia nā mea i pau ma ke ʻano he mea i hana ʻia.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Hoʻopili i ka faila Org mode i kākau ʻia e Emacs, Orgzly a i ʻole Beorg. Lilo nā poʻo inoa ma ka pae luna i mau papa inoa a nā poʻo inoa ma ka pae ʻelua i mau kāleka. Mālama ʻia ʻo TODO a me DONE, nā makakoho, nā lepili, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE a me CLOSED; lilo nā pahu kaha a me nā poʻo inoa ma nā pae hohonu aʻe i mau papa hōʻoia.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Hoʻopili i kahi waihona todo.txt: hoʻokahi hana ma kēlā me kēia lālani, e like me ka mea i kākau ʻia e ka polokalamu todo.txt a me nā polokalamu kūlike. Hele nā hana i pau ("x") i Pau, lilo ʻo +project a me @context i mau lepili, lilo ʻo (A) i lepili makakoho, a lilo ʻo due: a me t: i lā palena pau a me lā hoʻomaka.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: E kāpili i ka hopena o task export: he lālani JSON a i ʻole hoʻokahi hana ma kēlā me kēia laina. Hele nā hana i pau i Done, lilo ʻo project me priority i mau lepili, ʻo annotations i mau manaʻo, a ʻo depends i mau pilina hilinaʻi i nā hana e ālai ana.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: E wehe i ka waihona .boardarchive mai ka zip a kāpili i ka ʻike o ka board.jsonl o ka papa, me ka laina mana a i ʻole me ka ʻole o ia laina. Lilo ke ʻano hōʻuluʻulu o ka nānā papa i mau papa inoa, nā ʻano koho ʻē aʻe i mau lepili, nā ʻāpana kikokikona me nā pahu kaha i ka wehewehena a me ka papa nānā, a mālama ʻia nā manaʻo. ʻAʻole hoʻokomo ʻia nā kiʻi me nā waihona hoʻopili.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Ma Azure DevOps, e wehe iā Boards, a laila iā Queries, e holo i kahi nīnau e hōʻike ana i nā kolamu āu e makemake ai, a koho iā Export to CSV; e koho i kēlā faila .csv. Lilo ʻo Board Column (a i ʻole State) i nā papa inoa a ʻo Board Lane i nā ala; lilo nā mea hana i nā kāleka me ko lākou ʻano a me nā tags ma ke ʻano he lepili, Assigned To, nā lā, ka wehewehe a me ka makua, a lilo nā kolamu ʻē aʻe i nā kahua maʻa.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Ma Microsoft Lists, e wehe i ka papa inoa, koho iā Export, a laila iā Export to CSV, a koho i kēlā faila .csv. Lilo ke kolamu Status (a i ʻole Progress) i nā papa inoa a lilo kēlā me kēia mea i kāleka, me kona poʻo inoa, wehewehe, poʻe, nā lā a me nā tags; lilo nā kolamu ʻē aʻe i nā kahua maʻa.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Ma Microsoft Project, e koho iā File, a laila iā Save As, me ke ʻano XML Format (*.xml), a koho i kēlā faila. Lilo nā hana hōʻuluʻulu i nā ala a lilo nā hana i nā kāleka ma Not started, In progress a i ʻole Completed, me ko lākou mau lā, nā memo, nā kumuwaiwai, nā hana liʻiliʻi a me nā hana mua.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Ma Outlook, e kauo i nā leka i kahi waihona ma kāu kamepiula, a i ʻole e mālama iā lākou me File, a laila Save As, ma ke ʻano Outlook Message Format (*.msg). E koho i hoʻokahi faila .msg, a i ʻole he .zip o nā faila .msg a me .eml. Lilo kēlā me kēia kamaʻilio i kāleka ma Board View / Email, me kona mau pane he mau manaʻo a me kona mau mea pili he mau faila.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ma MeisterTask, kaomi i ka inoa papahana, koho iā Export project a hoʻopuka i ka CSV, a laila e hoʻopili mai. Lilo nā māhele i mau papa inoa a nā hana i mau kāleka, me ko lākou mau memo, lā palena, mea i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana a me nā lepili; mālama nā hana i pau i ko lākou lā i pau ai. Hiki nō hoʻi ke hoʻohana i ka CSV i kākau ʻia no ka hoʻokomo ʻana o MeisterTask ponoʻī.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ma Obsidian, wehe i ka faila o ka papa Kanban ma ke ʻano he Markdown (a i ʻole wehe i ka faila .md ma ka mea hoʻoponopono kikokikona), a laila e hoʻopili i nā mea a pau. Lilo nā ala i mau papa inoa me ko lākou mau palena kāleka; mālama nā kāleka i ko lākou mau lepili, lā, makakoho, kahua a me ka papa hōʻoia, a lilo ka Archive i mau kāleka i waiho ʻia i ka waihona.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ma Linear, hoʻopuka i nā pilikia ma ke ʻano he CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, a i ʻole ka hoʻopuka o kekahi nānā), a laila e hoʻopili i ka CSV. Lilo nā kūlana i mau papa inoa, nā hui i mau ala, a nā pilikia i mau kāleka me ko lākou mea i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana, nā lepili, lā, pilikia makua, makakoho, koho nui, papahana a me ka pōʻai.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ma TickTick, wehe iā Settings, Account, Backup & Import a hana i kope papaʻa, a laila e hoʻopili i ka faila CSV. Lilo kēlā me kēia papa inoa TickTick i ala a kona mau kolamu i mau papa inoa; mālama nā hana i ko lākou mau lepili, lā, papa hōʻoia, makakoho a me nā hana liʻiliʻi.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ma ClickUp, hoʻopuka i nā hana ma ke ʻano he CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, a i ʻole ka hoʻopuka o ka nānā List a i ʻole Table me nā kolamu a pau), a laila e hoʻopili i ka CSV. Lilo nā kūlana i mau papa inoa, nā papa inoa ClickUp i mau ala, a nā hana i mau kāleka me ko lākou mau hana liʻiliʻi, poʻe i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana, lepili, lā, makakoho a me ka manawa.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ma Nullboard, wehe i ka papa, koho iā Export this board... ma ka papa koho, wehe i ka faila .nbx ma ka mea hoʻoponopono kikokikona a hoʻopili i kona mau ʻike. Lilo nā papa inoa i mau papa inoa a nā memo i mau kāleka: ʻo ka lālani mua o ka memo ke poʻo inoa o ke kāleka, a ʻo ke koena kona wehewehe. Loaʻa i ka memo raw ka lepili raw. Inā nui nā papa o ka faila, hoʻokomo ʻia kona papa mua.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ma Kanri, wehe iā Import & Export a koho iā Export individual board (a i ʻole Export all data), a laila e hoʻopili i ka faila .json. Lilo nā kolamu i mau papa inoa a nā kāleka i mau kāleka, me ko lākou wehewehe, lā palena, lepili a me nā kala; lilo nā hana o ke kāleka i papa hōʻoia. Mai ka hoʻopuka ʻikepili a pau, hoʻokomo ʻia ka papa mua.
import-board-instruction-planka: E kikokiko i ka helu wahi o kāu Planka (e laʻa me https://planka.example.com), kou inoa mea hoʻohana a me kou ʻōlelo huna Planka, a laila e kaomi iā Papa inoa. Hoʻohana ʻia lākou no ka kiʻi ʻana i ka papa wale nō a ʻaʻole mālama ʻia. E koho i kekahi papa a kaomi iā Kiʻi: heluhelu ʻo WeKan iā ia mai ka API o Planka mai, me kona mau papa inoa, kāleka, wehewehe, lā palena, lepili, lālā, papa hana a me nā manaʻo, a laila e hoʻomau i ka hoʻokomo ʻana e like me ka maʻamau. Hoʻokomo ʻia nā kāleka i loko o ka waihona o Planka ma ke ʻano waiho ʻia; ʻaʻole hoʻokomo ʻia nā mea pili a me nā kāleka i loko o ka ʻōpala.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Ma Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), e komo, e ʻae i ka ʻae Tasks.Read a e kope i ka hōʻailona mai ka ʻaoʻao Access token. E hoʻopili iā ia ma ʻaneʻi a kaomi iā Papa inoa; hoʻohana ʻia ka hōʻailona no kēia kiʻi ʻana wale nō a ʻaʻole mālama ʻia. E koho i nā papa inoa a pau a i ʻole hoʻokahi a kaomi iā Kiʻi. Lilo kēlā me kēia papa inoa To Do i papa inoa a kēlā me kēia hana i kāleka, me kona mau memo, lā palena a me lā hoʻomaka, nā kaʻina ma ke ʻano papa nānā, nā māhele ma ke ʻano lepili, a me ke koʻikoʻi kiʻekiʻe a me ke kūlana ma ke ʻano lepili; waiho ʻia nā hana i pau. ʻAʻole hoʻokomo ʻia nā hoʻomanaʻo a me nā hana hou.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Ma Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), e komo, e ʻae i ka ʻae Notes.Read a e kope i ka hōʻailona mai ka ʻaoʻao Access token. E hoʻopili iā ia ma ʻaneʻi a kaomi iā Papa inoa; hoʻohana ʻia ka hōʻailona no kēia kiʻi ʻana wale nō a ʻaʻole mālama ʻia. E koho i kahi puke memo a kaomi iā Kiʻi. Lilo nā māhele i nā papa inoa a lilo nā ʻaoʻao i nā kāleka, me ko lākou kikokikona, nā pahu hana he papa nānā a me nā ʻaoʻao liʻiliʻi he mau hana liʻiliʻi.
import-board-instruction-teams: E hoʻopili i kahi hōʻailona komo Microsoft Graph me Chat.Read (mai Graph Explorer, he moʻokāki hana a kula paha) a kaomi iā Papa inoa, a laila koho i kahi kamaʻilio a kahawai paha a kaomi iā Kiʻi; ʻaʻole mālama ʻia ka hōʻailona. A i ʻole e koho i kahi faila: ka .tar o kāu hoʻopuka pilikino mai teams.live.com/dataexport, a i ʻole he .json o nā leka kamaʻilio. Lilo kēlā me kēia kamaʻilio i kāleka ma Board View / Chat, a ʻo kona mau leka nā manaʻo.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Ma Sandstorm, e wehe i ka grain o __app__, e koho i Download backup ma ka pahu luna o ka grain, a e koho i kēlā faila .zip. Lilo ka mea o loko o ka grain i papa, a ʻo kona mau mea i mau kāleka me nā mea a ka polokalamu e mālama ai no lākou. E koho i ka polokalamu nona ka grain: hōʻole ʻia ka grain o kekahi polokalamu ʻē aʻe, a haʻi ʻo ia i ka polokalamu.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Ma KanbanFlow, e wehe i ka papa koho o ka papa, koho iā Settings → API & Webhooks a kope i ka hōʻailona API o ka papa. E hoʻopili i ka hōʻailona ma ʻaneʻi, kaomi iā Papa inoa, koho i ka papa a kaomi iā Kiʻi; hoʻohana ʻia ka hōʻailona no ia kiʻi ʻana wale nō a ʻaʻole mālama ʻia. Lilo nā kolamu i papa inoa a noho mau nā ala i ala; mālama nā hana i ko lākou wehewehe, waihoʻoluʻu, lepili, lā palena, nā hana liʻiliʻi ma ke ʻano papa nānā, ka manawa i hoʻohana ʻia, ka manaʻo koho, nā kānaka a me nā manaʻo.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: E kikokiko i ka ID o kāu moʻokāki Basecamp (ka helu ma hope o basecamp.com/ ma ka helu wahi) a me kekahi hōʻailona komo (mai kekahi polokalamu OAuth 2 i kākau inoa ʻia ma launchpad.37signals.com, a i ʻole kekahi i loaʻa mua i kahi hoʻohui e kū nei), kaomi iā Papa inoa, koho i kekahi papahana a kaomi iā Kiʻi. Hoʻohana ʻia ka hōʻailona no ia kiʻi ʻana wale nō a ʻaʻole mālama ʻia. Lilo kēlā me kēia papaʻaina kāleka i ala me kona mau kolamu ma ke ʻano papa inoa, a lilo nā papa inoa hana e hana ai i ala Hana e hana ai; mālama nā kāleka a me nā hana i ko lākou kikokikona, nā lā, nā kānaka i hāʻawi ʻia a me nā manaʻo, lilo nā kaʻina o ke kāleka i papa nānā a waiho ʻia nā hana i pau.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: E kiʻi i kekahi hōʻailona komo mai ka OAuth 2.0 Playground: ma lalo o Tasks API v1 e koho iā tasks.readonly, kaomi iā Authorize APIs, a laila Exchange authorization code for tokens, a kope i ka hōʻailona komo. E hoʻopili iā ia ma ʻaneʻi a kaomi iā Papa inoa, koho i nā papa hana a pau a i ʻole hoʻokahi, a laila Kiʻi. Hoʻohana ʻia ka hōʻailona no kēia kiʻi ʻana wale nō a ʻaʻole mālama ʻia. Lilo nā papa hana i papa inoa a lilo nā hana i kāleka, me ko lākou mau memo, loulou a me lā palena; lilo nā hana liʻiliʻi i papa nānā a hoʻokomo ʻia nā hana i pau ma ke ʻano waiho ʻia.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: No nā moʻokāki Google Workspace wale nō ka API o Google Keep. E kiʻi i kekahi hōʻailona komo OAuth 2.0 me ka laulā https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (ma ka OAuth 2.0 Playground inā ʻae kou luna Workspace, a i ʻole mai kekahi moʻokāki lawelawe me ka ʻelele ma ke kāʻei kapu holoʻokoʻa), hoʻopili iā ia, kaomi iā Papa inoa a laila Kiʻi. Hoʻohana ʻia ka hōʻailona no kēia kiʻi ʻana wale nō a ʻaʻole mālama ʻia. Lilo nā memo kikokikona i kāleka ma ka papa inoa Memo, a lilo nā memo papa nānā i kāleka ma ka papa inoa Papa inoa me ko lākou mau mea ma ke ʻano papa nānā. ʻAʻole hoʻokomo ʻia nā memo i ka ʻōpala, nā mea pili a me ka kaʻana like.
api-import-desc: E kiʻi iā ia mai ka lawelawe me kāu moʻokāki ponoʻī. Hoʻohana ʻia ka mea āu e kikokiko ai ma ʻaneʻi no kēia kiʻi ʻana wale nō a ʻaʻole mālama ʻia.
api-import-list: Papa inoa o nā mea hiki ke hoʻokomo ʻia
api-import-fetched: Ua kiʻi ʻia. E nānā i nā lālā ma lalo a hoʻokomo.
api-import-failed: ʻAʻole i kō ke kiʻi ʻana
api-import-nothing: ʻAʻohe mea e hoʻokomo ai me kēia moʻokāki.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ma Pivotal Tracker, wehe i ka ʻaoʻao MORE o ka papahana a koho iā Export CSV (a i ʻole koho i nā moʻolelo a koho iā Bulk Actions, CSV), a laila e hoʻopili i ka CSV. Lilo kēlā me kēia kūlana moʻolelo i papa inoa a nā moʻolelo i mau kāleka, me ko lākou ʻano, lepili, poʻe nona, mea noi, lā, manaʻo, hana a me nā mea ālai; lilo ʻo Estimate i Story points a nā pōʻai hana i mau sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ma Tasks.org, wehe iā Settings, Backups a koho iā Export tasks, a laila e hoʻopili i nā ʻike o kēlā faila .json. Lilo nā papa inoa i mau papa inoa a nā hana i mau kāleka, me ko lākou mau memo, lepili, lā, manaʻo a me nā hana liʻiliʻi; mālama nā hana i pau i ko lākou lā i pau ai, a lilo ka makakoho i kahua hoʻopilikino.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ma monday.com, wehe i ka papa koho o ka papa, koho iā More actions a me Export board to Excel (me nā mea hou a me nā mea liʻiliʻi inā makemake ʻoe), a laila e koho i kēlā faila .xlsx. Lilo ke kolamu Status i mau papa inoa a nā hui i mau ala; mālama ʻia nā kānaka, lā, laina manawa a me nā lepili ma ko lākou mau wahi, lilo nā kolamu ʻē aʻe i mau kahua hoʻopilikino a nā mea hou i mau manaʻo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ma Super Productivity, wehe iā Settings, a laila Sync & Backup, koho iā Export Data a hoʻopili i nā ʻike o ka faila sp-backup .json. Lilo kēlā me kēia papahana i ala a nā hana i mau kāleka ma To Do, In Progress, Backlog a i ʻole Done, me ko lākou mau memo, lepili, lā palena, manawa i hoʻohana ʻia a me nā hana liʻiliʻi; lilo nā hana i waiho ʻia i ka waihona i mau kāleka i waiho ʻia i ka waihona.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ma Taiga, wehe iā Admin > Project > Export a hoʻoiho i ke kope ʻikepili papahana (e wehe mua i ka faila .json.gz), a laila e hoʻopili i kona JSON. Lilo nā kūlana moʻolelo mea hoʻohana i mau papa inoa, nā moʻolelo mea hoʻohana i mau kāleka me ko lākou mau hana ma ke ʻano he hana liʻiliʻi; loaʻa i nā epic a me nā pilikia ko lākou mau ala ponoʻī, a hele pū mai nā sprint, lepili, manaʻo a me nā ʻano hoʻopilikino. ʻAʻole hoʻokomo ʻia nā mea pili.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Ma Vikunja, wehe iā Settings, koho iā Data Export a hoʻoiho i ka faila .zip i hoʻouna ʻia iā ʻoe, a laila e koho i kēlā faila, a i ʻole e hoʻopili i ka data.json i loko. Lilo nā pūʻulu Kanban i mau papa inoa a nā hana i mau kāleka, me ko lākou mau lepili, poʻe i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana, lā, wehewehe, papa hana ma ke ʻano he papa hōʻoia a me nā manaʻo; lilo ka makakoho, pākēneka i pau a me ke kūlana pau i mau kahua hoʻopilikino. ʻAʻole hoʻokomo ʻia nā mea pili.
import-board-instruction-quire: Ma Quire, wehe i ka papa koho papahana a koho iā Export CSV, a laila e hoʻopili i ka CSV. Lilo nā kūlana i mau papa inoa a nā hana i mau kāleka, me ko lākou mau hana liʻiliʻi ma ke ʻano he kāleka keiki, poʻe i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana, lepili, lā hoʻomaka, lā palena a me ka lā i pau ai, wehewehe a me ka makakoho ma ke ʻano he kahua hoʻopilikino. ʻAʻohe manaʻo a me nā mea pili ma ka CSV o Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Ma Wrike, hoʻopuka i kekahi papahana a i ʻole waihona i Excel, a i ʻole hoʻopiha i ke kumu hoʻohālike hoʻokomo Excel o Wrike, a laila e koho i kēlā faila .xlsx. Lilo nā lālani waihona a me papahana i mau ala, ʻo Status i mau papa inoa a nā hana i mau kāleka, me ko lākou Key, hana makua, poʻe i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana, lā hoʻomaka a me ka lā pau, pilina hilinaʻi a me ka wehewehe; lilo ʻo Priority, Duration a me nā kolamu ʻē aʻe i mau kahua hoʻopilikino.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ma Teamwork.com, hoʻopiha i ke kumu hoʻohālike hoʻokomo hana Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) a mālama ma ke ʻano he .xlsx, a laila e koho i kēlā faila. Lilo nā papa hana i mau papa inoa a nā hana i mau kāleka; lilo ka hana e hoʻomaka ana me -, # a i ʻole > i hana liʻiliʻi o ka hana ma luna ona (--, ## a i ʻole >> no hoʻokahi pae hohonu aʻe). Mālama ʻia ka poʻe i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana, nā lā a me nā lepili ma ko lākou mau wahi; lilo ʻo Priority, Estimated time a me Complete i mau kahua hoʻopilikino.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Ma Businessmap (ʻo Kanbanize kona inoa ma mua), wehe iā Advanced Search, koho iā Configure results e koho i nā kolamu, hoʻoiho i ka faila Excel, a laila e koho i kēlā faila .xlsx. Heluhelu ʻia nā kolamu ma ko lākou mau inoa Pelekānia (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): inā hoʻohana kāu moʻokāki i kekahi ʻōlelo ʻē aʻe, e hoʻololi mua i ka lālani poʻo inoa i ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia. Lilo ʻo Column i mau papa inoa a ʻo Lane i mau ala; mālama ʻia ka poʻe nona, nā lepili, kala, lā, manaʻo a me nā loulou makua ma ko lākou mau wahi, a lilo ʻo Priority, Size, Type a me nā kolamu ʻē aʻe i mau kahua hoʻopilikino.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Ma Redmine, wehe iā Issues o ka papahana, koho iā Also available in: CSV ma lalo o ka papa inoa, koho i nā kolamu (All columns, me Description) a hoʻopuka, a laila e hoʻopili i ka CSV. Hoʻopaʻa ʻo Redmine i nā inoa kolamu ma kāu ʻōlelo, no laila e koho i ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia ma My account ma mua o ka hoʻopuka ʻana. Lilo kēlā me kēia kūlana i papa inoa a nā pilikia i mau kāleka, me ka tracker ma ke ʻano he lepili, ka mea i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana, mea kākau, lā, hana makua a me nā pilikia pili; lilo ka makakoho, māhele, mana i manaʻo ʻia, manawa i koho ʻia, % Done a me nā kahua hoʻopilikino i mau kahua hoʻopilikino.
import-board-instruction-notion: Ma Notion, wehe i ka waihona ʻikepili ma ke ʻano he ʻaoʻao piha, koho iā ••• a me Export, koho iā Markdown & CSV, a koho i ka faila .zip i hoʻoiho ʻia, a i ʻole hoʻokahi CSV waihona ʻikepili mai loko mai, a i ʻole e hoʻopili i kēlā CSV. Lilo ke kolamu i kapa ʻia ʻo Status i mau papa inoa (inā ʻaʻohe, hoʻohana ʻia ke kolamu mua i like me ke koho, a hōʻike ka hōʻike hoʻokomo i ke kolamu i koho ʻia); lilo nā lālani i mau kāleka me ko lākou poʻo inoa, lepili, kānaka ma ke ʻano he lālā, lā, a me ke kikokikona ʻaoʻao ma ke ʻano he wehewehe; lilo nā kolamu ʻē aʻe i mau kahua hoʻopilikino. ʻAʻole hoʻokomo ʻia nā pilina, kiʻi a me nā mea pili.
import-board-instruction-plane: Ma Plane, wehe iā Workspace Settings, koho iā Exports, hoʻopuka i nā papahana ma ke ʻano he JSON, CSV a i ʻole Excel a hoʻoiho i ka faila .zip, a laila e koho i kēlā faila, a i ʻole hoʻokahi faila mai loko mai, a i ʻole e hoʻopili i ka JSON a i ʻole CSV. Lilo nā kūlana i mau papa inoa, nā papahana i mau ala, a nā pilikia i mau kāleka me ko lākou hōʻailona, makua, poʻe i hāʻawi ʻia i ka hana, lepili, lā, loulou a me nā manaʻo; lilo ka makakoho, koho nui, pōʻai a me ka module i mau kahua hoʻopilikino. ʻAʻohe wehewehe a me nā mea pili ma ka hoʻopuka o Plane, no laila ʻaʻole hoʻokomo ʻia lākou.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Ma Fizzy, e hoʻopuka i ka moʻokāki ma "Account settings", a i ʻole i kāu mau kāleka me "Download my data", a e koho i ka waihona .zip a Fizzy e hoʻouna mai ai iā ʻoe, a i ʻole i ka waihona .json o hoʻokahi kāleka. Lilo nā papa i mau ala a lilo nā kolamu i mau papa inoa, me "Maybe?", "Not now" a me "Done" e like me Fizzy; mālama nā kāleka i ko lākou wehewehe, nā lepili, nā mea i hāʻawi ʻia, nā kaʻina ma ke ʻano he papa nānā, nā manaʻo a me nā waihona.
import-board-instruction-mail: E koho i kekahi waihona .mbox, e like me ka mālama ʻana o Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt a i ʻole Gmail ma o Google Takeout, a i ʻole hoʻokahi leka .eml, a i ʻole e kāpili i kona kikokikona. Lilo kēlā me kēia kamaʻilio i hoʻokahi kāleka ma ka papa inoa Inbox, me kona mea hoʻouna, nā mea loaʻa a me ke kumuhana, i ʻike ʻia ma ka nānaina Email; lilo nā pane i kona mau manaʻo. Lilo nā lepili Gmail i nā lepili. ʻAʻole hoʻokomo ʻia nā mea pili.
import-board-instruction-ical: E koho i kekahi waihona ʻalemanaka .ics, e like me ka hoʻopuka ʻana o Google Calendar, Apple Calendar a i ʻole Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud a i ʻole Outlook, a i ʻole e kāpili i kona kikokikona. Heluhelu ka hoʻokomo i kēlā JSON i hoʻopili ʻia ma luna, mai WeKan a i ʻole GET /workflows o Wrike, i loko o ka papa i koho ʻia: lilo ke kūlana papa inoa ʻole i papa inoa, a hōʻailona kekahi lula i ke kāleka ua pau ke hoʻoneʻe ʻia i ke kūlana Completed a i ʻole Cancelled, a ʻaʻole i pau ma Active a i ʻole Deferred. ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻopuka i nā lula hana ʻakomi ponoʻī o Wrike mai Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: `__operator_user__:<username>` - nā kāleka wahele *<username>* he he *lālā* a i ʻole *akakikanee*

globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - nā kāleka pelonakinaka i he papa akakikaneka i hui *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - nā kāleka pelonakinaka i he papa akakikaneka i kime *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - nā kāleka wahika he kue upa i *<n>* nā lā mai kēia manawa.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ nā papa inoa a pau nā kāleka pakaka keila laā palena.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - nā kāleka wahika wele hana ʻia *<n>* nā lā ako a i ʻole emi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - nā kāleka wahika wele mokipieka *<n>* nā lā ako a i ʻole emi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - wahele *<status>* he one o ka polalowinaka:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - a pau waihona ʻia a unalakileka nā kāleka
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - nā kāleka me he laā hoʻopau
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - nā kāleka wale nō i lehulehu nā papa
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - nā kāleka wale nō i pilikino nā papa
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - wahele *<field>* he one o `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` a i ʻole `__predicate_member__`.  palakinaka he `-` i palonaka o *<field>* kealakeka pola ka apakenake o he waiwai i kaka pielaka (e.ka. `loaʻa:-kue` kealakeka pola nā kāleka wikouka he laā palena).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - wahele *<sort-name>* he one o `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` a i ʻole `__predicate_modified__`.  pola he kekakenakinaka kolaka, palake he `-` i palonaka o ka kolaka inoa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - wahele *<n>* he he pokikile inakekela ekapalekakinaka ka numapela o nā kāleka i he kikapalaweka pela ʻaoʻao.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
kimilala opelakolaka he *OR*eka kokekela.  nā kāleka kaka makaka kekahi o ka konakikionaka wilala he lekulaneka.
`__operator_list__:loaʻa __operator_list__:ālai ʻia` woulaka lekulana nā kāleka konakaineka i kekahi papa inoa nameka *ālai ʻia* a i ʻole *loaʻa*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: kipapelinaka opelakolaka he *AND*eka kokekela.  wale nō nā kāleka kaka makaka a pau o ka kipapelinaka opelakolaka he lekulaneka.  `__operator_list__:loaʻa __operator_label__:ʻulaʻula` lekulanaka wale nō nā kāleka i ka papa inoa *loaʻa* me he *ʻulaʻula* lepili.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: nā lā hiki he kapekipieka aka he pokikile a i ʻole nekakile inakekela a i ʻole ukinaka `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` a i ʻole `__predicate_year__` pola ka kēia manawa pelioka.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: na paʻamau waihona ʻia nā kāleka he ʻaʻole kealakeka.

s3-minio-storage-description: ka3-komapakipale opakekaka kakolake: AWS ka3, minio, kaloukapalale la2, pakakapalake pa2, wakapi, kikikalokeana kapakeka a okelaka.

s3-sse-description: Hoʻopāʻālua ʻo S3 i kēlā me kēia mea pili, alakalaka a me ke kope mālama a WeKan e kākau ai, a wehe i ka pāʻālua no WeKan ke heluhelu ʻia.
s3-sse-kms-key-id: ID kī KMS no SSE-KMS (hakahaka = ke kī paʻamau o ka moʻokāki)
azure-connection-string-description: opakionala: hoʻohana he pulala pilina kakalinaka inakakeaka o moʻokāki inoa a kewa.
database-migration-description: mikalake kekakapakeka ʻikepili (elelawakinaka ekakepaka nā mea hoʻopili a alakalaka, wahika kakawa ma ka pilekawakakema) ma waena monakokapa a pelalekakapa la1 (kakalike). ka ʻē aʻe kakapake mukaka he lunaninaka a leakapale (paʻamau polakaka: pelalekakapa monakokapa://127.0.0.1:27018, monakokapa monakokapa://127.0.0.1:27019; olelalike me WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). ma hope ika pinikeka, poinaka MONGO_URL ma ka ʻē aʻe kakapake a lekakalaka wekana (ma kanapa: kanapa keka wekana kakapake=pelalekakapa a i ʻole =monakokapa).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: mikalake kikokikona ʻikepili i pelalekakapa la1 (kakalike)
database-migration-confirm: kope a pau kekakapakeka kolalekakionaka i __db__? nā mea hoʻopili a alakalaka ma ka pilekawakakema he ʻaʻole apapekakeka. ka kalakeka kakapake mukaka he lunaninaka.
sandstorm-migration-description: wahena wekana lunaka inakike he kanakakakolama kalaina, ikaka olaka monakokapa 3 kakapake he mikalakeka i pelalekakapa la1 (kakalike) ma mua launaka, a nā mea hoʻopili a alakalaka he neʻe ʻia mai ka kakapake i ka kalainaka nā waihona/nā mea hoʻopili a nā waihona/alakalaka kilekakolieka. kēia kowaka wahekela kaka mikalakiona kukakeekeka a howa muka kikaka kapake ka olaka lawa monakokapa kakapake nā waihona kakilala hoʻohana inakike ka kalaina, a lekaka ʻoe holoi koke lawa nā waihona i palee kapake.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: holoi lawa monakokapa kakapake nā waihona
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: ma hope he kukakekakapula mikalakiona ka ʻikepili lileka i pelalekakapa a ma ka pilekawakakema, ko ka olaka lawa monakokapa 3 kakapake nā waihona hiki he holoi ʻia i palee kalaina kikaka kapake. kēia ʻaʻole hiki he unakone.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: holoi ka lawa monakokapa 3 kakapake nā waihona i palee kikaka kapake? ka ʻikepili loaʻa ua ua mikalakeka i pelalekakapa a ka pilekawakakema. kēia ʻaʻole hiki he unakone.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: lawa monakokapa kakapake nā waihona holoi ʻia, paleeka
features-desc: Nā hana koho i hāʻawi ʻia e WeKan. Hūnā ʻia ka hana i koho ʻole ʻia mai nā mea hoʻohana a pau. Mālama ʻia kona ʻikepili, a ʻaʻole hoʻololi ʻia nā ʻae.
feature-views-table-desc: Ka papa ma ke ʻano he pākaukau kāleka e hiki ke hoʻokaʻina ʻia.
feature-views-calendar-desc: ʻAlemanaka a me ka ʻalemanaka no nā papa he nui.
feature-views-time-desc: Manawa a me ka laina manawa.
feature-views-overview-desc: Nā helu, ka hui ʻana ma ka mea i hāʻawi ʻia ai ka hana, ka hoʻolālā hana, ka papa hoʻokele a me ka papa nui.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Nā ʻano nānā ʻekolu o ka pakuhi Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Nā hana huahana i koe, nā wā hana pōkole, ka hōʻike no ia wā a me ka māmā o ka hana.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Ka hana i koe, ka hana i pau, ke kahe i hōʻuluʻulu ʻia, ka manawa pōʻai a me ka manawa mai ke noi a i ka pau ʻana, ka nui o nā hana i pau, ka lōʻihi o ke kali ʻana o nā hana, nā mea keʻakeʻa, Monte Carlo a me nā ana kahe ʻē aʻe.
feature-views-map-desc: Nā kāleka ma ke ʻano he mau hōʻailona ma luna o ke kiʻi i hoʻouka ʻia.
feature-awaiting-approval: (hou, ke kali nei i ka ʻae)
feature-approval-required: E waiho pio i nā hana i hoʻohui ʻia e nā hōʻano hou o WeKan a hiki i ka hoʻā ʻana o kekahi luna hoʻokele
feature-preview-admins: ʻIke nā luna hoʻokele i nā hana i hoʻopio ʻia i hiki ke hoʻāʻo mua iā lākou
feature-pilot-users: Nā mea hoʻohana hoʻāʻo e ʻike pū ana i nā hana i hoʻopio ʻia
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Nā inoa mea hoʻohana, hoʻokaʻawale ʻia e nā koma
feature-profiles-desc: Hūnā ka moʻokāki i nā hana i kaha ʻia mai nā mea hoʻohana, nā kime a me nā hui i hāʻawi ʻia ai. Haʻi ʻia ka mea hoʻohana i ka moʻokāki āna. ʻAʻohe pili i ka mea ʻaʻohe ona moʻokāki, ʻaʻohe ʻikepili i holoi ʻia a ʻaʻohe ʻae i loli.
feature-profile-teams: Nā kime, hoʻokahi ma ka lālani
feature-profile-orgs: Nā hui, hoʻokahi ma ka lālani
feature-profile-notice: Hūnā kou moʻokāki hana __name__ i nā hana he __count__. E nīnau i kahu hoʻomalu inā pono ʻoe i kekahi o ia mau hana.
activities-and-notifications: Nā hana a me nā hoʻolaha
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Ua mālama ʻia. ʻAʻole i loaʻa kēia mau inoa mea hoʻohana:
card-field-visibility-desc: Nā kahua o Hoʻonohonoho Papa / Kāleka e hiki ai i nā papa ke hōʻike. Hūnā ʻia ke kahua i kaha ʻole ʻia mai kēlā me kēia kāleka, kāleka liʻiliʻi a me Hoʻonohonoho Papa / Kāleka o nā papa a pau. ʻAʻole hoʻololi ʻia ka ʻikepili kāleka a me nā hoʻonohonoho papa, a ke kaha hou ʻia, hōʻike ʻia kēlā me kēia papa e like me kona hoʻonohonoho mua. Na kēlā me kēia papa kona kaʻina kahua ponoʻī.
cards-loading-auto: ʻakomi (lakawa wale nō pola pika nā papa)
cards-loading-description: wekana loakaka papa nā kāleka ʻakomi: he pika papa (olela ka nui kalekolaka) loakaka wale nō ka nā kāleka kulalenakalawa likipale (inapinike kakalolala) paluka he lile helu, ko ika kakawaka pakaka a ukeka emi memolawa a panakawikaka, wahile kamalalela nā papa loaka kēlā me kēia kāleka pola ka kimapalekaka, pulalawa peakuleka ekapelienake. kele he nokinaka i hoʻonohonoho. opelakolaka hiki kakilala polake he moke me ka CARDS_LOADING (a pau/lakawa/auko) a CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD enalilonamenaka laliapaleka.
cards-loading-lazy-note: lakawa kāleka ke hoʻouka nei he ekapelimenakala: kāleka kounakelaka a WIP limikaka he akakulake, puka ka ʻalemanaka/kapale/kanakaka liewaka a mulakikelekaka lepalekaka wale nō ka nā kāleka loakeka ko pala. leloaka wehe nā papa ma hope kanakinaka kēia.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: wahena ʻā, a pau linakaka (poka malakakowana linakaka like [lepili](ulala) a lawa HTML <a href> kakaka) he mau kowana aka palaina, nonakalikakapale kikokikona i kēlā me kēia lika kikokikona pielaka (papa a kāleka kikaleka, kekakalipakionaka, nā manaʻo, kekakalikakaka, ekaka.). kēia palelenakaka mikaleakinaka kalikakapale linakaka. paʻamau he pio, ko linakaka kakawa kalikakapale.
always-show-code-as-text: mau hōʻike a pau koke aka palaina kikokikona
always-show-code-as-text-description: wahena ʻā, lika kikokikona he ʻaʻole loa lenakeleka aka malakakowana a i ʻole HTML: ka enakile koulake he mau kowana aka palaina kikokikona i kēlā me kēia lika kikokikona pielaka (papa a kāleka kikaleka, kekakalipakionaka, nā manaʻo, kekakalikakaka, ekaka.). kēia lelealaka hikakena ʻike — HTML nā manaʻo (<!-- -->), ka kalakeka o malakakowana linakaka, kalakakalipaka a kekahi ʻē aʻe koke — ko a pau koke he mau likipale, ʻaʻole kalikakapale, a ʻaʻole lunaninaka. paʻamau he pio, ko malakakowana he lenakeleka nolamalalawa.
disable-all-import-description: wahena ʻā, a pau hoʻokomo peakuleka he kulaneka pio: imapolakinaka he papa mai wekana JSON, kalelalo, CSV/ekakela, kila, kanapoalaka, nekakakalouka kekaka, openapalokekaka, kikupa, kikalapa, kikea a polakeko, aka welala aka kaloninaka he papa. ka hoʻokomo papa koho opakionaka he hikakena a ka kikowaena lekekakaka kekahi hoʻokomo lekuekaka. paʻamau he pio.
import-max-megabytes-description: Ka faila nui loa e ʻae ʻia e ka ʻaoʻao Hoʻokomo, ma nā megabyte. ʻO ka hakahaka, ʻaʻohe palena: hiki i ka faila ke nui e like me ka wahi kaʻawale ma ka pā e hiki ai ke hoʻopau i ka hoʻokomo ʻana. Kākau ʻia kēlā me kēia hoʻouka ʻana ma ka pā o ke kikowaena i kēlā me kēia ʻāpana, a hōʻole ʻia ka hoʻokomo ʻana e hoʻopiha ana i ka pā.
import-disk-full: ʻAʻole lawa ka wahi kaʻawale ma ka pā o ke kikowaena no kēia hoʻokomo ʻana.
import-upload-not-found: ʻAʻole i laila hou ka faila i hoʻouka ʻia. E koho hou iā ia.
import-upload-failed: ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻouka i ka faila.
import-upload-aborted: Ua ʻoki ʻia ka hoʻouka ʻana.
disable-all-export-description: wahena ʻā, a pau hoʻokuʻu aku peakuleka he kulaneka pio: ekapolakinaka he papa aka wekana JSON, CSV, ekakela, kanapoalaka, a i ʻole i nekakakalouka kekaka / openapalokekaka / kikupa / kikalapa / kikea / polakeko, a kinakaleakakakamenaka hoʻokuʻu aku. ka hoʻokuʻu aku papa koho opakionaka he hikakena a ka kikowaena lekekakaka kekahi hoʻokuʻu aku lekuekaka. paʻamau he pio.
disable-import-avatars-description: wahena ʻā, alakalaka (mea hoʻohana palopile pikakuleka) he ʻaʻole loa hoʻokomo ʻia. kēia kolelaka wekana JSON hoʻokomo, kalelalo hoʻokomo, a kiʻi helehelena kawanaka mai ekakelanala ikenakikawa palolikelaka ma ʻeʻe (LDAP, OIDC/oauka2). nameka a ʻē aʻe ʻikepili he kakilala hoʻokomo ʻia; wale nō alakalaka he kakipapeka. paʻamau he pio.
disable-export-avatars-description: wahena ʻā, alakalaka (mea hoʻohana palopile pikakuleka) he ʻaʻole loa inakalukeka wahena ekapolakinaka he papa (wekana JSON a CSV hoʻokuʻu aku). ukelanameka a ʻē aʻe ʻikepili he kakilala ekapolakeka; wale nō alakalaka he omikakeka. paʻamau he pio.
anonymize-import-users-description: wahena ʻā, imapolakinaka he wekana JSON papa lepalakeka kēlā me kēia hoʻokomo ʻia ukelaka inoa mea hoʻohana, pulala inoa a inikialaka me kounakela palakeholakelaka (mea hoʻohana1, mea hoʻohana2, ...), kalopaka keila kiʻi helehelena, a lewalikeka @inoa mea hoʻohana menakionaka (a ka lekuekakekapawa / akakikanekapawa pielakaka) inakike hoʻokomo ʻia kāleka a manaʻo ʻike. ʻaʻole leala mea hoʻohana ikenakikawa mai ka koulake papa he kakoleka. ka wolaka "mea hoʻohana" polalowaka ka ʻōlelo o ka pelakona imapolakinaka. paʻamau he pio.
anonymize-export-users: anonawamike hoʻokuʻu aku nā mea hoʻohana
anonymize-export-users-description: wahena ʻā, ekapolakinaka he papa lepalakeka kēlā me kēia ekapolakeka ukelaka inoa mea hoʻohana, pulala inoa a inikialaka me kounakela palakeholakelaka (mea hoʻohana1, mea hoʻohana2, ...), kalopaka keila kiʻi helehelena, a lewalikeka @inoa mea hoʻohana menakionaka (a ka lekuekakekapawa / akakikanekapawa pielakaka) inakike kāleka a manaʻo ʻike. ka ekapolakeka waihona kalalieka ʻaʻole leala mea hoʻohana ikenakikawa. ka wolaka "mea hoʻohana" polalowaka ka ʻōlelo o ka pelakona ekapolakinaka. paʻamau he pio.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: wahena ʻā, ekapolakinaka he papa lepalakeka kēlā me kēia ekapolakeka ukelaka inoa mea hoʻohana, pulala inoa a inikialaka me kounakela palakeholakelaka (mea hoʻohana1, mea hoʻohana2, ...), kalopaka keila kiʻi helehelena, a lewalikeka @inoa mea hoʻohana menakionaka (a ka lekuekakekapawa / akakikanekapawa pielakaka) inakike kāleka a manaʻo ʻike. ka ekapolakeka waihona kalalieka ʻaʻole leala mea hoʻohana ikenakikawa. ka wolaka "mea hoʻohana" polalowaka ka ʻōlelo o ka pelakona ekapolakinaka. paʻamau he pio.
disable-activities-description: wahena ʻā, akakilikawapeeka enakalieka he ʻaʻole loa lekolakeka a ʻaʻole loa kowana anawawahele (papa kikepala a kāleka hana kapa). ʻaʻole mōʻaukala o waho kika wahaka he kepaka. paʻamau he pio.
disable-notifications-description: wahena ʻā, wekana ʻaʻole loa kenakaka wakaka nā hoʻolaha (inapapa, leka uila a i ʻole ʻē aʻe kelalikeka) pola kekahi hana. nā hana hiki kakilala he lekolakeka (unalekaka kekahi pio ma luna); wale nō ka nā hoʻolaha he kupapalekakeka. paʻamau he pio.
disable-watch-description: wahena ʻā, ka wakaka peakule he kulaneka pio — nā mea hoʻohana ʻaʻole hiki kupakakalipe i nā papa, nā papa inoa a i ʻole nā kāleka i lekeile nā hoʻolaha, a kekahi hoʻāʻo i hoʻololi he wakaka lelela he lekekakeka. paʻamau he pio.
backup-description: E kope mālama i nā mea hoʻopili, nā kiʻi mea hoʻohana a me/a i ʻole nā ʻikepili (nā pūʻulu kikokikona a pau ʻaʻole he mea hoʻopili a he kiʻi mea hoʻohana paha). Hoʻouna pololei ʻia ka .zip i kahi mālama i koho ʻia — ʻaʻohe waihona no ka manawa pōkole — ma ke ʻano he backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, me YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars a me /data i loko. Hoʻohana nā wahi mālama ao (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) i nā ʻike komo i hoʻonohonoho ʻia ma ko lākou mau kapu mālama.
backup-scope-description: ka wahole inakakanake, a i ʻole one hui. he olakanikakionaka kope mālama loaʻa ikaka nā papa a elelawakinaka ma kema, inakalukinaka ka nā mea hoʻopili o koke nā papa — puka ʻaʻole mea hoʻohana nā moʻokāki a ʻaʻole inakakanake nā hoʻonohonoho, no ka mea koke he kaleka na kēlā me kēia hui. lekakolinaka he olakanikakionaka kope mālama wale nō elela walikeka i nā papa kaka hui owanaka.
theme-override-all-tenants: olelalike kaka apapalieka i a pau kenanakaka
continuous-backup-description: Hoʻouna ʻia kēlā me kēia hoʻololi o ka waihona ʻikepili, nā mea hoʻopili, nā kiʻi mea hoʻohana a me nā moʻolelo hana i kekahi papa kuhikuhi waihona i loko o kekahi mau kekona, i hiki ke hoʻihoʻi i kekahi manawa. Hana pū kēia me ke kope mālama i hoʻonohonoho ʻia, nāna e hana i nā waihona papaʻa piha.
continuous-backup-enabled: E hoʻomau i ke kope mālama ma kēia kikowaena
continuous-backup-target: Papa kuhikuhi waihona e mālama ai (ala piha, ma kekahi pā hōkeo ʻē aʻe, kahi kaʻana like ma ka pūnaewele a i ʻole kahi i hoʻohui ʻia me rclone)
wekan-data-no-database: ʻAʻole i loaʻa kekahi waihona ʻikepili WeKan hiki ke heluhelu ʻia.
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (i ka manawa maoli, kēlā me kēia hoʻololi)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Nā ʻaoʻao SQLite (nā ʻaoʻao i hoʻololi ʻia i kēlā me kēia wā i hoʻonohonoho ʻia)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (polokalamu koho āu e hoʻouka ai)
continuous-backup-engine-chosen: Ke holo nei i kēia manawa
continuous-backup-engine-none: ʻAʻohe ʻenekini waihona ʻikepili e hiki ke holo ma kēia kikowaena
continuous-backup-sqlite-interval: Ka wā ma waena o nā hana SQLite (kekona)
continuous-backup-file-scan: Nānā hou i nā waihona a pau (kekona)
continuous-backup-base-every: Hana i kope kumu hou i kēlā me kēia (hola)
continuous-backup-encrypt: E hoʻopāʻālua i ke kope mālama (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Waihona kī hoʻopāʻālua (ala piha ma waho o ka papa kuhikuhi waihona e mālama ai; 64 huapalapala o ka ʻōnaehana helu kumu 16, a i ʻole he māmalaʻōlelo huna nona nā huapalapala he 16 a ʻoi). E mālama i kekahi kope: me ka ʻole o ia waihona, ʻaʻole hiki ke hoʻihoʻi i ke kope mālama.
continuous-backup-upload-none: ʻAʻohe wahi (ma ka papa kuhikuhi waihona e mālama ai wale nō)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Waihona ma loko o ka pahu mālama
continuous-backup-fetched: Ua kiʻi ʻia nā waihona mai ke ao
continuous-backup-restore-to: Hoʻihoʻi i (ka lā a me ka manawa)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Waihona ʻikepili SQLite (hana ʻia ma ka ʻaoʻao o ke kope mālama, ʻaʻole loa e kākau ma luna o ka waihona e hoʻohana ʻia nei)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: E hoʻohana i ka hōkeo ʻikepili SQLite i kūkulu hou ʻia i ka hoʻomaka hou aʻe (e mālama ʻia ka hōkeo ʻikepili kahiko i pani ʻia)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: E hoʻihoʻi i ka hanauna i koho ʻia i ka manawa i koho ʻia? Hoʻomaha iki ke kope mālama hoʻomau i ka wā e hoʻihoʻi ana.
continuous-backup-saved: Ua mālama ʻia nā hoʻonohonoho kope mālama hoʻomau
backup-restore-select-first: koho he kope mālama mai ka papa inoa mua.
backup-restore-confirm: E hoʻihoʻi i ke kope mālama i koho ʻia? Kākau ʻia nā mea hoʻopili/nā kiʻi mea hoʻohana i ka ʻōnaehana waihona a me nā ʻikepili i ka waihona ʻikepili e like me ke ʻano i koho ʻia.
gcs-key-filename-description: opakionala: paka i he kelalike moʻokāki JSON kewa waihona ma ka kikowaena.
gcs-credentials-description: opakionala: kāpili ka kelalike moʻokāki JSON kewa. leale palanaka i hoʻohana ka kewa waihona a i ʻole paʻamau kalekenakialaka.
gcs-permissions-note: kile wekanaka kelalike moʻokāki leaka/walike komo i ka pukakeka: kookale kalouka konakole → kalouka kakolake → pukakekaka → kāu pukakeka → nā ʻae komo → kalanaka komo. i "hou palinakipalaka", kāpili ka kelalike moʻokāki leka uila — ka "mea kūʻai_emaila" waiwai mai kāu JSON kewa — kena koho ka kuleana "kakolake opakekaka luna hoʻokele" a mālama.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: leale palanaka i keepa ka kēia manawa waiwai.
azure-account-name-description: ka inoa o kāu akule kakolake moʻokāki.

email-recovery-description: Hoʻokahi lālani no kēlā me kēia mea loaʻa. E huli ma ka ID mea hoʻohana. ʻAʻole hōʻike ʻia ka ʻike o nā memo a me nā kahua leka uila o ka mea loaʻa. Mā ka hoʻomaha e hoʻopaʻa i nā memo o kēia manawa a me nā memo e hiki mai ana; mā ka hoʻomau e hoʻāʻo hou e hoʻouna i nā memo e kali nei i kēia manawa. Mā ka hoʻopau e kāpae i nā memo i hoʻokomo ʻia i ka lālani a hiki i ka manawa o ke noi. Inā e hoʻouna ʻia ana kekahi memo, e hoʻāʻo hou ma hope iki. ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻihoʻi mai i ka memo i hoʻomaka ʻia ka hoʻouna ʻana, a hiki ke hoʻouna hou ʻia ka memo i maopopo ʻole ka hopena o kona hoʻouna ʻana. Mālama ʻia nā hemahema mau a me nā memo i hiki i ka palena hoʻāʻo no ka nānā hou ʻana. Mā ka hoʻāʻo hou i nā memo i hāʻule ka hoʻouna ʻana e hoʻomaka i pōʻai hoʻāʻo hou a mālama i ka hoʻomaha e kū nei.

optional-apis-desc: Nā REST API ma ke ʻano o nā API o nā mea hahai ʻē aʻe, i hiki i kā lākou mau polokalamu a me nā script ke hoʻohana i kēia WeKan i kahua hope: ʻo ka mea a lākou e mālama ai, mālama ʻia ia ma WeKan, ma nā papa WeKan. Pio kēlā me kēia a kikoʻi ʻia ma ʻaneʻi. ʻAʻohe ona kuleana ponoʻī: komo kekahi mea kūʻai me kahi hōʻailona API WeKan a hiki iā ia ke ʻike a hoʻololi i nā mea wale nō a ia kanaka e hiki ai ke ʻike a hoʻololi ma WeKan. Pono lākou a pau e ʻā ka REST API WeKan (WITH_API=true). ʻO ka helu wahi ma lalo o kēlā me kēia ka mea a ka mea kūʻai e hoʻohana ai i kāna kikowaena.
optional-api-trello-desc: Hana nā polokalamu a me nā script i kākau ʻia no ka REST API o Trello (e laʻa me Trellinator) me WeKan: nā papa, nā papa inoa, nā kāleka, nā lepili, nā lālā, nā manaʻo a me nā papa nānā. ʻO ka hōʻailona Trello he hōʻailona API WeKan. Ke holoi ʻia kekahi kāleka, hoʻoneʻe ʻia ia i ka waihona ma WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Hana nā mea kūʻai o ka REST API v2 o Jira me WeKan: he papa kekahi papahana (ʻo kona kī ke kī o ka papa), he kāleka kekahi pilikia (DEV-7), he papa inoa kekahi kūlana, a hoʻoneʻe kekahi hoʻololi i ke kāleka. Ua ʻae ka huli i ka JQL maʻalahi: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text a me ORDER BY. E komo me kahi hōʻailona API WeKan i ʻōlelo huna. Ke holoi ʻia kekahi pilikia, hoʻoneʻe ʻia ia i ka waihona.
optional-api-github-desc: Hana nā mea kūʻai o ka REST API o GitHub no nā pilikia me WeKan: he papa kekahi lepokikolawa, he kāleka kekahi pilikia, me nā lepili, nā pahuhopu (nā lepili me ka lā palena), nā manaʻo, a me ka wehe ʻia a pani ʻia paha e like me ka Nānaina papa / Hoʻomalu Mana. ʻO ka hōʻailona he hōʻailona API WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Hana nā mea kūʻai o ka REST API o Gitea a me Forgejo no nā pilikia me WeKan, e like me ka API kūpono me GitHub: he papa kekahi lepokikolawa a he kāleka kekahi pilikia. ʻO ka hōʻailona he hōʻailona API WeKan.

shop-show-on-public-note: Wehe ka papa ākea ma hoʻokahi nānā wale nō. Ke koho ʻia ka hale kūʻai ma ʻaneʻi, pani ia i ka __view__ no nā malihini, a ke koho ʻia ke Kahua pūnaewele a i ʻole kekahi nānā ʻē aʻe ma Nā hoʻonohonoho papa / papa nānā, pani ia i ka hale kūʻai.
shop-cart-empty: ʻAʻohe mea i loko o kou kaʻa kūʻai.
shop-empty: ʻAʻohe huahana i kēia manawa. He huahana ke kāleka me ke kumukūʻai ma kekahi papa inoa kūʻai.
shop-accept-terms: Ke ʻae nei au i nā kuleana a me nā kūlana
shop-privacy-note: Kākau ʻia kou inoa a me kou ʻike hoʻokaʻaʻike ma ke kauoha i hiki i ka hale kūʻai ke hāʻawi aku, ʻaʻole ma kahi ʻē aʻe.
shop-price-changed: Ua loli kekahi kumukūʻai. E nānā i ka huina hou a kauoha hou.
shop-confirmation-email: E hoʻouna i ka hōʻoia kauoha i ka mea kūʻai ma ka leka uila
import-board-instruction-wordpress: Ma WordPress, koho iā Tools, Export, All content a me Download Export File, a koho i kēlā faila .xml ma ʻaneʻi a i ʻole e kāpili i kona kikokikona. Hana like ʻo Squarespace, Wix a me nā kahua ʻē aʻe e hoʻopuka ana i kekahi faila WordPress. Lilo kēlā me kēia ʻaoʻao a me ka pou i kāleka ma ka papa inoa o kona kūlana, nā ʻaoʻao ma ke ala Pages a me nā pou ma Posts, me kona ʻike, kona mau māhele a me nā tags ma ke ʻano he lepili, a me kona mau manaʻo i ʻāpono ʻia.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: E mālama i nā pou a me nā ʻaoʻao o ka REST API o WordPress (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts a me /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) ma ke ʻano he faila .json hoʻokahi, a koho iā ia ma ʻaneʻi a i ʻole e kāpili. Lilo kēlā me kēia ʻaoʻao a me ka pou i kāleka ma ka papa inoa o kona kūlana.
import-board-instruction-ghost: Ma Ghost, koho iā Settings, Labs, Export your content, a koho i ka faila .json ma ʻaneʻi a i ʻole e kāpili. Lilo kēlā me kēia ʻaoʻao a me ka pou i kāleka ma ka papa inoa o kona kūlana, me kona mau tags ma ke ʻano he lepili.
import-board-instruction-blogger: Ma Blogger, koho iā Settings, Back up content, a koho i ka faila .xml ma ʻaneʻi a i ʻole e kāpili i kona kikokikona. Lilo kēlā me kēia pou a me ka ʻaoʻao i kāleka, he kāmua ma ka papa inoa Draft, me kona mau lepili a me nā manaʻo.
import-board-instruction-markdownsite: E hoʻopili i nā kumu o kekahi kahua paʻa Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro a i ʻole kekahi ʻē aʻe i .zip - nā faila Markdown me ko lākou front matter, a me ko lākou mau kiʻi - a koho i ka .zip ma ʻaneʻi. Lilo kēlā me kēia faila Markdown i kāleka: nā pou mai nā waihona posts a i ʻole me ka lā ma ka inoa faila, ʻo ke koena nā ʻaoʻao, nā kāmua ma ka papa inoa Draft, a me nā kiʻi āna e hoʻohana ai ma ke ʻano he mau mea pili.
import-board-instruction-htmlsite: E hoʻopili i nā faila o kekahi kahua pūnaewele i .zip - kona mau ʻaoʻao .html a me nā kiʻi, e like me ka mālama ʻia e wget a i ʻole HTTrack, a i ʻole ka hoʻopuka a Medium - a koho i ka .zip ma ʻaneʻi. Lilo kēlā me kēia ʻaoʻao i kāleka me kona kikokikona nui, a me nā kiʻi āna e hoʻohana ai ma ke ʻano he mau mea pili; waiho ʻia nā script, nā papa koho a me nā palapala.
import-board-instruction-substack: Ma Substack, koho iā Settings, Exports, Create new export, a koho i ka .zip i hoʻoiho ʻia ma ʻaneʻi. Lilo kēlā me kēia pou i kāleka me kona kikokikona, i paʻi ʻia a i ʻole he kāmua.
help-board-view-swimlanes-what-it-is-des: Swimlanes divide the board into horizontal bands, so each card belongs to both a list and a swimlane. A lane can stand for a team, a person, a customer or a kind of work, while the lists keep showing the stages of the work.
help-board-view-swimlanes-how-it-works-d: Click + in a swimlane header, or choose Add Swimlane in its menu, type a name and choose whether it goes above or below the selected lane. Pasting several lines can create one swimlane per line. Click a name to rename it, use the caret to collapse or expand a lane, drag its handle to reorder lanes, and drag its bottom edge to change its height unless a board admin has locked resizing.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: Lists are the columns that hold the cards. On a kanban board each list is a stage of the work, and a card moves from list to list as the work goes on. In Swimlanes view a list can belong to one swimlane.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Click the add list icon at the right end of a list header, or Add in the list menu, type a name and choose which list it comes after; pasting several lines can create one list per line. Click a list title to rename it, and the caret in its header collapses or expands it just for you. The list menu also has copy, move and archive, and you can drag the handle between lists to resize them when resizing is allowed.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: The Table view shows the board's cards as a spreadsheet-like table, one row per card, with its list, swimlane, people, labels and dates. It is handy for scanning many cards at once and for adding or moving cards without dragging them across lists.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Click a column header to sort, and click it again to reverse the order. Type in the search box to match card titles, lists, swimlanes and labels, and use Previous and Next to page through 25 rows at a time. The Edit button opens a card over the table. Wrap titles and Group by swimlane change the layout and are remembered in this browser. Archived cards are left out, and the sidebar Filter narrows the rows.
help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: The Calendar view places the board's cards on a calendar by their dates: a card with start and end dates as a bar between them, and its received, due and end dates as their own entries. Dated checklist items appear too.
help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Use Today, Previous and Next to move around, and switch between day, week and month, each as a grid or a list. Drag a card to give it a new due date, or stretch it to change its end date. Click a day, or drag over hours in the week or day grid, to create a new card due then; it goes to the board's first swimlane and first list.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Calendar Mode shows each card on the day of its due date, with its labels and full title, in a month or week grid. It is a read-only overview of what is due when, similar to the Trello calendar.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Use Today, Previous and Next to move by a month or a week, and Week or Month to switch the grid; the choice is remembered in this browser. Click a card to open it. Archived cards are left out and the sidebar Filter applies. To change dates by dragging, use the Calendar view instead.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Multi Board Calendar shows the dated cards of every board you are a member of in one calendar, so you can see everything due this week no matter which board it is on. Each entry starts with its board's title in brackets.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: Open it from the Board View menu of any board and wait until the cards of all your boards have loaded. Use Today, Previous and Next and the day, week and month views, each also as a list. Received, due and end dates get their own entries. Click an entry to open that card on its board. Dates cannot be dragged here.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: The Time view gathers the board's time tracking in one place: how much time has been spent, by whom and on which cards, and how much time is left until cards are due. Time is entered on the cards themselves; this view only reports it.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Read the time spent summary at the top, then the breakdown by assignee and by card, with overtime cards marked. Below it every change to a card's recorded hours is listed by the person who made it. Click Export to save the report as PDF or Excel. Members who may only see cards assigned to them get the summary for their own cards, while the other sections stay empty.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: The Timeline view shows the board as it was at an earlier moment, using the board's history. It helps you see what changed and put a card back the way it was.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Click a point on the line to see each card as it was then, grouped by its list at that time, with its title, description, labels, members and due date. Click Now to return to the present. On a card, Restore to this state sets those values back after you confirm. Nothing is deleted: the restore is recorded as new history, and the button is shown only to people who may change that card.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Statistics shows the board's status at a glance: how its cards are loaded and how many swimlanes, lists, cards, archived cards, labels, members and custom fields it has.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Open Statistics from the Overview group of the Board View menu and read the Board status table. Card loading tells whether this board loads only the visible cards or all cards, and whether that was chosen automatically for a big board. The counts are computed on the server, so they are right even on a large board. Any value can be selected and copied, and opening the view changes nothing.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Group by Assignee lists every card under the person it is assigned to, instead of under its list, so you can see who has what without opening each list. It suits a team meeting.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: Open it from the Board View menu. Each assignee gets a section with their cards, the due date where one is set and a clock when a card is over time; cards without an assignee are under No assignee. Click a card title to open the card. The grouping uses the card's Assignee field, not its Members. People whose role only lets them see cards assigned to them get no data here.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: The Gantt views draw the board's cards on a calendar so you can see what starts, what is due and what overlaps. Gantt is a table with one row per card and an icon for each of its dates, while Frappe Gantt and DHTMLX Gantt draw each card as a bar from start to end.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Choose Gantt, Frappe Gantt or DHTMLX Gantt in the Calendar and time group of the Board View menu; cards need at least one received, start, due or end date. In Gantt, each week with dates gets its own table; click a card name to open the card or a date icon to edit that date. In Frappe Gantt and DHTMLX Gantt, members with write access can drag a bar to reschedule the card.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: The Product Backlog is the ordered list of work a Scrum team has not yet taken into a sprint. It shows the board's cards that have no current sprint, ordered by backlog rank, without moving them out of their lists.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Find a card in the table and, in its Actions cell, set its Sprint, Backlog rank, Release, Work item type and Acceptance criteria, then click Save. Smaller ranks come first. Hold Ctrl, or Cmd on a Mac, to put a card in several releases. Click a card title to open the card, and Show more to load the next 100 cards. Editing follows the usual card permissions.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: A sprint is a short, fixed period in which a Scrum team finishes a chosen set of work toward a goal. The Sprints view is where the board's sprints are planned, started, closed or cancelled, along with its releases and Scrum events.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: A board admin first opens Scrum settings, turns on Scrum planning and chooses the estimate source, unit, completion policy and working days. Then create a planned sprint with a name, goal, start and end, assign cards to it from the Product Backlog, and click Start sprint. To finish, choose where unfinished work goes and click Close sprint, or give a reason and click Cancel sprint. Only board admins manage sprints.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: A sprint report tells what happened in one closed sprint: what was committed, completed, added, removed and left unfinished. Velocity lists those results for every closed sprint, so the next sprint can be planned from what the team really did.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: In Sprint Report, choose a sprint and choose Cards or Estimate above the bars, then read the daily scope and remaining work and the change-by-change history below. In Velocity, read one row per closed sprint. Results come from snapshots taken when each sprint started and closed, so later estimate changes do not rewrite them. Export saves the results as PDF or Excel, and Refresh reloads the report.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: These Scrum charts show progress over time. Burndown shows how much work is left day by day and Burnup how much is done, Velocity shows how much each closed sprint completed, Release Burndown follows the work left in a release, and Epic Progress shows how far parent cards have come.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Choose the chart under Scrum in the Board View menu. Each draws from the board's own cards and sprints and shows the numbers in a table under the chart. Velocity needs at least one closed sprint, and lets you choose Cards or Estimate. Click Export at the top to save the same numbers as PDF or Excel. A chart with nothing to draw yet says No results.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: The Roadmap groups cards into rows by the value of a custom field, such as a release or an epic, and draws each row's cards on a timeline. It is useful for a release or theme roadmap when that grouping is already kept in a custom field.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: The board needs at least one text or dropdown custom field. Choose the field in Group by at the top; each value gets its own small Gantt chart of its cards, and cards without a value are grouped under No value. Cards are placed by their dates, so give them start and due dates to see them on the timeline.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: These Overview charts answer how busy the board is and how its work is spread: Dashboard and Pulse summarize the board, Workload shows who has what, Distribution how cards are divided, Dependency Map how cards block or depend on each other, and Activity Heatmap when people work on the board.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Choose a chart in the Overview group of the Board View menu. Each page draws the chart from the board's cards and history and shows the table of numbers behind it. Click Export at the top to save the same data as PDF or Excel. When there is nothing to draw yet, the chart says No results.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: Bigboard stacks every board you are a member of on one scrollable page, each with its own lists and cards, so you can work on all your boards at once.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Open Bigboard from the Board View menu and wait while every board's cards load. Each board section works like a normal board: drag cards between lists, open cards and edit lists. You can also drag a card into a list of another board on the page, which moves it to that board. Lists can only be dragged within their own board. Click a board's title to open it on its own.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: The Kanban flow charts show how work moves through the board: cumulative flow, control and cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, throughput, WIP, aging work, blockers, forecasts of when work will be done, process behavior and whether bigger estimates take longer. They help you find where work piles up and how long it really takes.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Choose a chart in the Kanban flow group of the Board View menu. Read the note under the title, which says how it measures, then the chart and the table under it. Some pages take settings, such as target cards and date for Monte Carlo Forecasts or the size field for Work Item Size vs. Cycle Time, applied with Apply. Export at the top saves the tables as PDF or Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: These reports show how work flows through the board week by week: cards created and finished, net flow, how long cards stay in each list, the average age of open cards, the weekly throughput and how often due dates are met.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Choose a report in the Kanban flow group of the Board View menu: Created vs. Resolved, Net Flow, Time in List, Average Age, Throughput Run Chart or Due Date Performance. Each shows a chart and, under it, the table of numbers it is drawn from. Click Export at the top to save that table as PDF or Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: The Map view shows the board's cards as markers on an image the board admin uploads, such as a floor plan or site map. It suits work that happens in places, like rooms, machines or plots.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: A board admin clicks Upload a map image and chooses a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file, and can remove it later without losing the card places. People who may change the board see the cards that are not on the map yet; drag one onto the image, or choose it and click where it belongs, and drag a marker to move it. A marker takes the colour of the card's first label, and clicking it opens the card.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: The Email view shows the board as a mailbox: cards are the messages, lists are the folders and labels are the labels. You can write and answer email from the board's own address, so replies come back to the board as cards and comments.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Click Inbox, Sent, All mail, a list or a label to choose what is shown, type in the search box to narrow the rows, and click a row to open the card, whose comments are the conversation. Compose writes a new email and the reply arrow answers one, sent from the board's address. The board must first receive email, turned on in the board's Notification Settings under Email to card.
help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: The Chat view shows the board as a chat workspace: each card with a conversation is a channel and its comments are the messages. The channel tree covers every board you can see, with the number of messages you have not read.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Open a workspace and a board in Channels and click a card; it opens in the middle pane and its messages in the chat pane. Type a message and press Enter or click Send; Shift+Enter starts a new line. To start a conversation on a card with no messages, click Show all cards for that board and pick the card. The panes are mirrored for right-to-left languages.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: The Version Control view shows the board as a code repository's issue tracker: cards are issues, labels are labels, labels with a due date are milestones, comments are the conversation and attachments are the files. It also imports and syncs issues from GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Browse open and closed issues, filter by label or milestone, and open an issue to read and add to its conversation. A card counts as closed when it is archived or in a list such as Closed or Done. New issues become cards in the board's open list, and Close or Reopen moves the card between the open and closed lists. Everything is ordinary card data, so changes are kept in the board's history.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Column sets let you arrange the same cards in extra ways, such as by priority, milestone or size, without moving any card out of its list. Each set has its own coloured columns.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: A board admin types a name in New column set and clicks Add, then adds columns with a name and colour. Choose a set at the top; every card is in one of its columns or in Not placed. Drag a card to another column to change its place in this set only; its list, swimlane, labels and members stay the same. Each card also shows small labels for its column in the other sets.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: The Website view shows the board as a website built from its own cards and attachments, for example a site imported from WordPress, Ghost, Blogger or a static site. A public board can open in this view, so visitors see the site at the board's address.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: Cards in a list named Published are on the site, or every list's cards when there is no such list; archived cards never show. Cards in a swimlane named Pages form the menu, with subtasks as sub-pages, and the other cards are posts on the front page, newest first. A card's description is the page text and its attachments are its images and files. To use it as a public board's view, choose it in Board Settings / Board View.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: The Shop view shows the products on the board's cards as a web shop, with pictures, prices, categories, a product page, a cart and a checkout. A card in a list on sale becomes a product when its price field has a number, and its labels become categories.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: A board admin sets the shop up in Board Settings / Shop: the price, product code and stock fields, a private Orders list, the currency, VAT, payment methods, the lists on sale and the labels shown as categories, then ticks The shop is open. Shoppers filter by category, add products to the cart and check out. Each order becomes a new card in the Orders list, and the buyer gets a confirmation email.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: The Filter shows only the cards that match what you choose, such as labels, members, assignees, dates, custom field values, card text or how long cards have been in a list. It changes no card and nobody's access, and a combination of filters can be saved under a name and used again.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Choose labels, people, dates or other conditions in the sidebar, and the board shows only the matching cards. Under Labels, OR matches any selected label and AND requires all of them; clicking a selected label again excludes it. Card text applies as you type. Closing the panel keeps the filter on until you clear it. Global Search, also here, finds cards across all your boards.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: Search finds the cards and lists of this board whose text contains what you type, and shows each card found on the board itself. On All Boards the same button narrows your list of boards by title.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Type in the field and press Enter. The sidebar lists matching lists and cards, and the first card opens on the board with a counter under the field. Press Enter again for the next card or Shift+Enter for the previous one; the arrows do the same and wrap around. Click a card or list in the results to show it on the board, and click Search again to close the sidebar.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: Multi-Selection lets you tick several cards and then do one thing to all of them at once: set a label or member, change the colour, move, copy or archive them. On All Boards it selects boards instead.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Turn on Multi-Selection in the board header, then tick the cards' checkboxes, or use Filter to selection in the Filter sidebar to select every card the filter shows. Choose an action in the sidebar, such as Set label for selection, Move selection or Move selection to Archive. Click Turn Multi-Selection off, the X beside the header button, when you are done. You need permission to change the board.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: Custom fields are the board's own extra fields for cards, such as a version, a budget, a customer, a checkbox or a choice from a list. A field is defined once for the board, and each card can hold its own value for it.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Click + to create a field, give it a name and a type (text, number, date, dropdown, multi-select dropdown, checkbox, currency or string template) and choose where it is shown: on the card, on the minicard, on new cards or on every card. The type cannot be changed later. Number and currency fields can show their sum at the top of each list. Card values are then filled in on the opened card.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: The Archive holds the cards, lists and swimlanes that were moved to the Archive. Archiving hides something without losing it, so it can be restored later, while deleting removes it for good.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Choose the Cards, Lists or Swimlanes tab and click Restore beside an item, or Restore all. A card may not be restorable while its list is archived or full under its WIP limit, and the Archive says so. Board admins also see Delete and Delete all, which cannot be undone. Archived boards are restored from the Archive page of All Boards instead.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: Original positions shows where each swimlane, list and card was put when it was made, and which of them have moved since. It is useful after a big rearrangement, or to see the title a card was created with.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Read the three groups, Swimlanes, Lists and Cards. Each item shows its current name, Moved when it is no longer where it was put, the place it was created in, its original title when that has changed, and when it was made. Click Refresh to read the board's history again. Items made before positions were recorded have no row.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: Summary is a standup report of what happened on the board, person by person, taken from the board's own records. It answers what each of us did in the last day or week, and what is overdue.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Choose Last day or Last week. Each member who did something or has overdue cards gets groups for cards Done, Moved, Added and Commented, plus their Overdue cards, and each card opens from its link. Click Copy as text to copy the whole summary, ready to paste into a chat or an email.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: Since your last visit lists what other people changed on this board since you last had it open: new cards, moves, comments, due date changes and members added. The menu entry shows the number of changes.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: Opening the board records your visit. Open this view to see the changes grouped by card, newest first, and click a row to open that card. Your own changes are not listed. An administrator can hide the feature in Admin Panel / Settings / Features.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: Visibility decides who can see the board: only the people added to it (Private), every signed-in user of this WeKan (Signed-in users), or anybody with the link (Public). Editing stays with the board's members unless a board admin allows otherwise.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: A board admin clicks the visibility button in the board header and chooses Private, Signed-in users or Public; the current choice has a check mark and the button then shows the new setting. On a Signed-in users or Public board, when the administrator allows it, the admin can also tick Everyone signed in can edit. For other people the button only shows the setting.
help-board-watch-what-it-is-description: Watch sets how much you hear about this board: Watching notifies you of every change, Tracking only of changes to cards you created or are a member of, and Muted of nothing. The setting is your own; other members choose theirs.
help-board-watch-how-it-works-descriptio: Click the watch button in the board header and choose Watching, Tracking or Muted; your current level has a check mark and the button shows the new level. If the change is refused, a message says why and nothing changes. The button is hidden when an administrator has turned watching off.
help-board-sort-cards-what-it-is-descrip: Sort Cards changes the order cards are shown in inside each list: by due date, title, creation time, votes or the board's label order. It changes only what you see, and no card is moved.
help-board-sort-cards-how-it-works-descr: Click Sort Cards in the board header and choose an order; the cards in each list follow it and the button says Sort is on. Click the X beside it to remove the sort and return to the order the cards were dragged into. The choice is kept in your browser across reloads. For Label order, a board admin can change the label order with Move up and Move down when editing a label.
help-board-settings-what-it-is-descripti: Board Settings collects everything that is set for this one board: its rules, planning, colour and background, dates, views, swimlanes, lists and cards, export and import, notifications, webhooks and archive. Most entries are for board admins; your role and the site's settings decide which ones you see.
help-board-settings-how-it-works-descrip: Open the board's right sidebar with the hamburger menu and click Board Settings. Pick an entry and its own popup or page opens. The entries are grouped: rules first, then the board's look, then how it is drawn, then what goes in and out of it, and last the archive.
help-board-settings-color-what-it-is-des: Change color sets this board's own colour theme, which every member sees on this board. It is a way to tell boards apart at a glance. Only board admins can change it.
help-board-settings-color-how-it-works-d: Click a theme swatch; it is applied at once, with no Save button. For the flat and clear themes you can also pick your own colours with the colour wheels and check them in the preview. A colour you set for yourself in Member Settings still takes precedence over the board colour for you.
help-board-settings-announcement-what-it: A board announcement is a message a board admin writes for everyone on this board, shown in a bar above the board's lists. Use it for notes every member should see, such as a deadline or a change in how the board is used.
help-board-settings-announcement-how-it-: Write the text, up to 2000 characters of plain text, tick Show it to everyone on this board, and click Save. Members see the bar until they close it with its X, which hides it only for them. When the announcement is edited, it is shown again to everyone.
help-board-settings-background-what-it-i: A background image is a picture shown behind the board's lists, and also as the board's tile on the All Boards page. It can be an image address on the web or a picture uploaded and stored in WeKan.
help-board-settings-background-how-it-wo: Type an image address in Background Image URL and click Save, or use Remove Background Image to clear it. To store a picture, click Upload background image and choose a file; uploaded pictures are listed below, where clicking one makes it the board's background, and the icons download or delete it.
help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: Date lets a board admin choose one date format for everyone on this board, instead of the format set for the whole site. The same popup has your own week number switch and, for board admins, calendar sync that puts the cards' due dates into a CalDAV calendar such as Nextcloud.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Tick the board's Date Format, pick a format and click Save; untick it to follow the site setting again. A member's own enabled format in Member Settings still wins. Show week of year switches week numbers on or off for you at once. For calendar sync, enter the calendar address, user name and an app password, tick the sync box and Save.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: All Boards Settings decides what this board's tile shows on the All Boards page, such as the card count of each list and the members' avatars. It also sets card aging, automatic archiving of untouched cards, and whether list widths are personal or shared.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Tick or untick a row and it is saved at once. With card aging on, write three numbers of days after which cards fade in steps. For auto-archive, write how many days without activity a card may stay before it is archived, or leave it empty to turn that off. Templates are never archived.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: Board View chooses which views, such as Swimlanes, Lists, Table, Calendar, Gantt or the charts, are offered in this board's Board View menu, and which one the board opens in. It is set separately for when the board is public and when it is private.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: The popup has one row per view and four checkboxes: the default view and the shown views for a public board, and the same two for a private board. Tick a view's Show box to offer it in the menu and its Default box to open the board in it.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: Swimlane holds the board-wide swimlane settings: whether swimlanes can be dragged, whether their height can be resized, whether all swimlanes share one row of list headers, and which Scrum fields a swimlane shows. WIP Limit Groups, shared work-in-progress limits over several lists, are also here.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Tick the boxes you want; the Draggable checkbox is in the table at the top. One shared list header row shows every swimlane with all of the board's lists under one header row that stays on top, without changing the lists. Click WIP Limit Groups at the bottom to add or edit shared limits.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: List holds the board-wide list settings: whether lists can be dragged, whether their width can be resized, whether every list has the same width, and the Scrum field a list shows. It also turns on the Kanban flow policies: list policies, lists split into Doing and Done, a commitment point and a WIP limit per person.
